sections.body: These Terms & Conditions apply to registrations for Sekhon Indian Air Force Marathon 2026, scheduled for 4 October 2026 at Air Force Station Suratgarh.

sections.heading: 1. Event Registration
sections.body: Participants must provide complete and accurate information while registering for the marathon. Registration will be considered complete only after the required registration fee has been successfully paid and the registration has been confirmed.

sections.heading: 2. Registration Fees
sections.body: The Suratgarh registration fees are 5 KM: ₹399; 10 KM: ₹499; 21 KM: ₹499. Pay only the amount shown with the configured Suratgarh payment details after registration opens.

sections.heading: 3. Registration Deadline
sections.body: Registrations are scheduled to close on 27 September 2026. Registration may also close earlier if participant capacity is reached.

sections.heading: 4. Participant Information
sections.body: Participants are responsible for ensuring that the name, mobile number, email address, race category, T-shirt size and other information submitted during registration is correct.

sections.heading: 5. Race Categories
sections.body: Participants must participate only in the race category for which they have registered. Requests for race-category changes will be subject to availability and approval by the event organisers.

sections.heading: 6. Race Timing and Results
sections.body: Timing uses an organiser-managed race clock and finish-line recording. Participant-submitted times are identified as self-reported. Competitive results and any prizes require organiser-recorded or verified results. Use your unique registration ID for entry, results and certificates.

sections.heading: 7. Race Day Benefits
sections.body: The planned participant package includes an event T-shirt, medal, digital certificate, food and refreshments, subject to confirmed event arrangements. T-shirt collection is on 3 October 2026, from 09:00 to 13:30, in front of SBI Bank inside the station. Certificate eligibility follows the event completion rules.

sections.heading: 8. Participant Fitness & Safety
sections.body: Every participant is responsible for assessing their own physical fitness and ability to participate. Participants should seek appropriate medical advice before participating if they have any health concerns. All participants must follow instructions issued by event officials, security personnel, medical teams and race marshals.

sections.heading: 9. Event Changes
sections.body: The organisers may modify race timings, routes, reporting instructions, event arrangements or other operational details when required due to safety, security, weather, government directions or circumstances beyond reasonable control.

sections.heading: 10. Conduct
sections.body: Participants are expected to maintain appropriate behaviour and comply with all event and venue rules. The organisers may refuse participation or disqualify a participant for unsafe, disruptive or inappropriate conduct.

sections.heading: 11. Photography & Event Media
sections.body: Photographs and videos may be captured during the event for event documentation, promotion and related communication. Any use of participant images will be handled in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: 12. Payments
sections.body: Online payments may be processed through third-party payment service providers. Participants must complete the payment using the payment methods made available during registration.

sections.heading: 13. Refunds & Cancellations
sections.body: Refund and cancellation requests will be governed by our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

sections.heading: 14. Privacy
sections.body: Personal information collected through registration will be handled according to our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Suratgarh contact
sections.body: For Suratgarh event, registration or privacy assistance, contact the organising team on +91 8838463776 or +91 7027964880.
This Privacy Policy explains how information provided by participants through the Sekhon Indian Air Force Marathon 2026 website and registration process is collected and used.

sections.heading: Suratgarh registration and storage
sections.body: This site also collects date of birth, city, blood group, participant type, consent, and a payment screenshot with its transaction reference. Email sign-in and a station invitation code control registration access. Registration records and screenshots are held in restricted database and file storage for authorised event administration. Screenshots are not published on the website. For minors, a parent or guardian must provide the information and consent.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: During marathon registration, we may collect your full name, mobile number, email address, age, gender, selected race category, T-shirt size, emergency contact information, and payment and transaction-related information.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: Participant information may be used to process marathon registrations; confirm payments and registrations; manage race categories and participant records; prepare T-shirts and race-related materials; provide event updates, important notices and participant support; manage safety and emergency requirements; and issue certificates and other event benefits.

sections.heading: 3. Payment Information
sections.body: Payments may be processed using third-party payment gateway providers. Payment information processed directly by the payment provider is subject to that provider's security and privacy practices. We may receive payment-related information such as payment status, transaction reference number and amount for registration verification and reconciliation.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing of Information
sections.body: Personal information may be shared only when reasonably necessary with service providers involved in operating the event, such as payment processors, registration service providers or authorised event personnel. We do not sell participant personal information.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
sections.body: Reasonable administrative and technical measures are used to protect participant information from unauthorised access, misuse, alteration or disclosure. However, no method of electronic storage or internet transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
sections.body: Participant information may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary for event administration, payment reconciliation, participant support, legal compliance and legitimate record-keeping purposes.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies & Website Information
sections.body: The website may use basic cookies or technical information required for website functionality, performance and security. Third-party services integrated with the website may also use their own technologies according to their respective privacy policies.

sections.heading: 8. Participant Rights
sections.body: Participants may contact us to request correction of inaccurate personal information or to raise questions regarding their information, subject to applicable legal and event-record requirements.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Information
sections.body: Where registration of a minor is permitted, registration should be completed with the involvement and consent of a parent or legal guardian as applicable.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated when required. The latest version published on this website will apply.

sections.heading: Suratgarh contact
sections.body: For Suratgarh event, registration or privacy assistance, contact the organising team on +91 8838463776 or +91 7027964880.

sections.heading: Results and Certificate Verification
sections.body: Results are associated with your registration record. Authorised organisers may record or review finish times and corrections. A certificate verification link displays only necessary certificate information, such as participant name, race category, completion status and certificate identifier. Contact information and payment proofs are not public. Approved signature assets and generated certificate files are handled by protected backend services.
This Refund & Cancellation Policy applies to registrations made for Sekhon Indian Air Force Marathon 2026.

sections.heading: 1. Registration Fees
sections.body: Registration fees are 5 KM – ₹399; 10 KM – ₹499; 21 KM – ₹499. No payment is accepted until Suratgarh payment details are published and registration opens.

sections.heading: 2. Participant Cancellation
sections.body: Once a registration has been successfully completed and confirmed, the registration fee is generally non-refundable. Refunds will not normally be provided for a change of mind after registration, failure to attend the event, personal scheduling conflicts, travel-related issues, failure to complete the race, or disqualification due to a violation of event rules.

sections.heading: 3. Duplicate Payment
sections.body: If the same participant is charged more than once for the same registration due to a technical or payment-processing issue, the duplicate payment may be eligible for refund after verification.

sections.heading: 4. Payment Deducted but Registration Failed
sections.body: If payment is successfully deducted but the registration is not generated or confirmed due to a technical issue, please contact the event support team with the transaction details. After verification, the registration may be confirmed or the eligible payment may be refunded.

sections.heading: 5. Event Cancellation
sections.body: If the event is cancelled by the organisers and no alternative event arrangement is provided, eligible registrations may be refunded according to the cancellation announcement issued by the organisers.

sections.heading: 6. Event Rescheduling
sections.body: If the event is rescheduled, existing registrations may be transferred to the revised event date. Any refund option, where applicable, will be communicated by the organisers.

sections.heading: 7. Changes Due to Safety or Unavoidable Circumstances
sections.body: Race routes, timings or event arrangements may be changed because of weather, safety concerns, security requirements, government directions or circumstances beyond reasonable control. Such operational changes do not automatically create an entitlement to a refund.

sections.heading: 8. Refund Processing Time
sections.body: Where a refund is approved, it will normally be initiated within 7–10 business days. The time required for the refunded amount to appear in the participant's account may vary depending on the bank or payment service provider.

sections.heading: 9. How to Request a Refund
sections.body: For an eligible refund request, contact us with the participant's name, registered mobile number, race category, payment amount, transaction or payment reference number, and the reason for the refund request.

sections.heading: Suratgarh contact
sections.body: For Suratgarh event, registration or privacy assistance, contact the organising team on +91 8838463776 or +91 7027964880.
